title: G-Class W461
verdict: The G that never went to finishing school: W460 body, W463 running gear, rubber floors and a 24-volt habit. Armies bought it by the thousand, and the few civilians who could get one bought the best tool Mercedes ever made.

paragraphs: When the G-Class split in two at the end of the 1980s, the [[g-class/w463|W463]] got the leather, the wood and the attention. The W461 got the work. It kept the [[g-class/w460|W460]]'s body and chassis, gained the W463's drivetrain, and spent three decades carrying soldiers, medics, foresters and border police where roads give out. It's the G-Class with the luxury removed and the useful parts kept: barn doors, panel vans, cab-chassis trucks, three locking diffs and, on military trucks, a 24-volt electrical system.

story.heading: TWO Gs FROM ONE
paragraphs: Mercedes showed the luxurious W463 in 1989, and W460 production ended in 1991. For buyers who needed a tool rather than a status symbol, the W460 became the W461 in 1990, initially as the 230 GE and 290 GD, and the series was formally introduced in 1992. Wikipedia sums up the formula as the W460's chassis and body with the W463's powertrain, built specifically for militaries, public authorities and NGOs.

The split shows in the details. The W463 got no panel vans and no barn doors; those stayed exclusive to the W461. The W461 kept the narrow body, the plain dash and, on government trucks, 24-volt electrics. Some military trucks carried the 461 designation even earlier: the Argentine Army began using a 'model 461' in 1981.

story.heading: THE WOLF AND ITS PACK
paragraphs: Mercedes' own timeline lists the Bundeswehr receiving 12,500 'Wolf' G-Wagens under 1992; Wikipedia, which dates deliveries from 1993, puts the total at more than 12,000. Expedition Motor Company, which restores them, describes the 250 GD Wolf as an ex-military W461. By its definition a true Wolf is a two-door convertible with a fold-down windscreen and frameless windows, and it left the factory with a diesel engine.

Other armies joined the pack. Canada ordered 1,159 G-Wagons from late 2003 as its Light Utility Vehicle Wheeled, replacing the VW Iltis, with turreted, non-turreted and military-police versions. The US Marine Corps bought 157 Interim Fast Attack Vehicles based on a modified 290. Norway, Greece and Finland ran Gs from 240 GDs to armoured 270 CDIs. Australia replaced its army Land Rovers with W461s, and a 2010 Australian tender produced a 6×6 version of the 461 range.

story.heading: DIESELS THAT GOT SERIOUS
paragraphs: The engines started out painfully slow. The 1992 290 GD made 95 PS from a naturally aspirated 2.9-litre five-cylinder and took more than 25 seconds to reach 100 km/h. In 1998 the 290 GD Turbodiesel replaced it, with direct injection, about 120 hp, a driver's airbag and an automatic gearbox only. Common rail arrived with the G 270 CDI in 2001. For 2007 the G 280 CDI brought the 3.0-litre V6 diesel, detuned to 135 kW and 400 Nm so it could cope with poor-quality fuel.

story.heading: CIVILIANS ALLOWED, BRIEFLY
paragraphs: For the G-Class's 30th birthday in 2009, Mercedes sold the W461 to civilians as the G 280 CDI EDITION.30 PUR. It was a long-wheelbase wagon with four hard-wearing seats, rubber floors, drain holes in the footwells, a walk-on bonnet, flexible wheel-arch flares, headlamp grilles and barn doors. It sold well enough to spawn the G 280 CDI Professional in 2009 and the G 300 CDI Professional in 2010, offered as a wagon, panel van, cabriolet and cab-chassis.

Australia, where the army had adopted the W461, got the cab-chassis in 2016 and the wagon in 2017. Civilian production ended in 2019. Military trucks continued until 2022, when the W464 replaced them; Mercedes announced it on 1 October 2021. The W461 is the bridge between the W460 and today's working Gs, and the closest thing to a new W460 anyone could buy in the 2010s.

callout.label: SIDEBAR · CANNING STOCK ROUTE
callout.title: The day the plain G rescued the posh ones
paragraphs: To demonstrate what the G-Class could do, seven of them set out from Halls Creek to Wiluna along the Canning Stock Route, one of the country's most notorious tracks. On day seven its corrugations broke the shock absorbers on six of them: five civilian G 350s and one military model.

Mercedes-Benz Australia flew replacement shocks to Perth and then by light plane to a remote Aboriginal settlement near Well 33, about 1,000 km from Wiluna. The truck that went to fetch them was the only one still running: a G-Professional, the W461.

engineering_intro: Under the plain body the W461 is a W460 chassis carrying W463 running gear. That means a separate ladder frame, coil-sprung solid axles front and rear, and permanent four-wheel drive through a two-speed transfer case with three individually selectable locking differentials. In late G 300 CDI Professional form, the result is a 41:1 crawl ratio and a cab-chassis that can carry more than two tonnes.

engineering.note: The W460's chassis and narrow body, kept for military, agency and NGO buyers.

buying_checks.head: Know which W461 you're looking at
buying_checks.body: Ex-military trucks such as the Bundeswehr Wolf, the civilian EDITION.30 PUR and the G 280/300 CDI Professional are all W461s, but they differ in electrics, equipment and paperwork. Check the VIN and the Mercedes data card rather than the seller's description.

buying_checks.head: 24-volt systems
buying_checks.body: Military W461s run 24 V, and parts follow suit. Expedition Imports sells separate 12 V and 24 V heater blower motors, for example. Make sure accessories, lights and chargers match the system, and that no previous owner has half-converted it.

buying_checks.head: Rust in the usual G places
buying_checks.body: These are steel bodies on a steel frame, and ex-fleet trucks often lived outdoors. Handsome Motors' G checklist covers the windscreen gasket, door hinges, rear spring perch mounts, the metal under the tail-lights and rear door, and the body seams; Autocar adds the inner wheel arches.

buying_checks.head: Cardan shaft recall (late diesels)
buying_checks.body: Autocar reports that Mercedes recalled G 280 CDI and G 300 CDI models built between 4 April 2016 and 13 September 2021: the cardan shaft can strike the clamping body, causing power loss and transmission failure. Confirm the recall work has been done.

buying_checks.head: Lockers and low range
buying_checks.body: Engage low range, then each lock in turn on loose ground. If a lock won't engage, specialists say to flush the hydraulic system first before chasing parts.

buying_checks.head: Springs and shocks
buying_checks.body: Autocar notes that G-Class coil springs crack, especially in cold weather, and a loud thump over bumps is the clue. Ex-fleet trucks may have had hard lives, so check the dampers and the bushings on the radius arms and Panhard rods.

buying_checks.head: Set your expectations on pace
buying_checks.body: A naturally aspirated 290 GD makes 95 PS and needs 25–27 seconds to reach 100 km/h. The 1998–2001 turbodiesel, the CDIs and the G 300 CDI are far happier at highway speed.

repairs.title: Cardan shaft recall check
repairs.cost: Recall work is done by Mercedes
repairs.symptoms: On affected G 280 CDI and G 300 CDI trucks built from 4 April 2016 to 13 September 2021: power loss or drivetrain failure caused by the cardan shaft striking the clamping body.
repairs.fix: Give the VIN to a Mercedes-Benz dealer and ask whether the cardan-shaft recall is open. If it is, book it in before using the truck hard. Keep the paperwork, because buyers will ask.

repairs.title: Front axle service (bearings, kingpins, swivel seals)
repairs.symptoms: Weeping from the steering-ball swivel housings, wheel-bearing play, clicking CV joints, torn boots.
repairs.fix: Strip each corner to the knuckle: hub, wheel bearings, kingpin bearings, steering-ball gasket and wipe seals, inner axle seal, CV joint and boot. Expedition Imports sells complete front axle kits for the W460 and for 2001-and-older and 2002-and-newer W463s. Kingpin parts differ for 2002-on trucks, which need a different lower bearing. Match the kit to your axle number and build year before ordering.
repairs.tools: Front axle service kit for your axle · kingpin bearing kit (to 2001) or the 2002-on kit · steering-ball wipe seal 460 331 01 80 (fits all G-Wagens; one per side) · hub-nut socket

repairs.title: Locker won't engage
repairs.symptoms: Lock indicator stays dark, a lock drops out under load, or one lock works and another doesn't.
repairs.fix: Handsome Motors, which has owned more than 200 Gs, says to have the hydraulic system flushed before anything else. Check the flex lines; on many W461s the rear locker line is paired with the front brake hose, so replace both. Bleed the system and retest. If a lock still won't move, rebuild the slave cylinder on that axle and check the indicator switch and its boot.
repairs.tools: Front brake / rear locker flex line 460 420 50 48 (all W460 and many W461) · slave cylinder rebuild kit 460 350 07 84 · indicator switch boot 601 546 03 35 · brake bleeding kit

parts.name: Diff-lock slave cylinder rebuild kit (late style)

repairs.title: Springs and shocks
repairs.symptoms: A thump over bumps (a cracked coil), sagging ride height, a wallowing or bouncy ride, oily shock bodies. Corrugated roads kill shocks: see the Canning Stock Route sidebar.
repairs.fix: Support the chassis on stands, take the axle's weight on a jack, remove the shock and sway-bar link, and lower the axle carefully until the spring can be lifted out, without overextending the brake hoses and locker lines. Fit springs in matched pairs using the correct Mercedes colour code for your wheelbase and load, then refit the shocks and torque everything at ride height.
repairs.tools: Koni Raid shocks (W460/461/463) or OE dampers · colour-coded W460-pattern springs (e.g. front LWB 460 321 06 04, rear LWB 460 324 07 04; confirm fitment for your truck) · jack and stands · spring compressor if required

repairs.title: Steering box reseal
repairs.symptoms: Fluid weeping from the bottom of the steering box, low power-steering fluid, vague steering.
repairs.fix: The W461 uses the same LS2 steering box family as the W460 and W463. Replace the sector-shaft seal at the bottom of the box: disconnect the drag link and pull the pitman arm. Heavy play calls for the bearing set and a box rebuild.
repairs.tools: Sector-shaft seal 016 997 13 47 · steering box bearing set · pitman-arm puller

repairs.title: No heat or fan (24-volt blower)
repairs.symptoms: The blower is dead or works on only some speeds, or a fuse blows repeatedly.
repairs.fix: Check the fuse, switch and resistor before buying a motor. When replacing the motor, order the right voltage, because Expedition Imports lists separate 12 V and 24 V blower motors for these trucks.
repairs.tools: 24 V blower motor 000 830 35 08 (12 V version 000 830 13 08) · multimeter · trim tools

repairs.title: Sagging doors and hinge rust
repairs.cost: Hinge pin $8.50; rear hinge seal $22.20; door seal $113.30 (Expedition Imports)
repairs.symptoms: Doors that drop when opened and need a slam to latch, wind noise, and bubbling paint or rust around the hinges. Handsome Motors lists every door hinge as a G rust zone.
repairs.fix: The W461 uses the W460 body, so W460 door parts apply. Support the door, drive out the worn hinge pins and fit new ones. Swap the rear-door hinge seals while the hinges are accessible, using the original recessed seals rather than stick-on replacements. Treat any rust under them. Replace hardened door seals if water or wind gets past them.
repairs.tools: Hinge pin 460 723 00 52 · rear single-door hinge seal or barn-door hinge seal 460 743 00 78 · door seal 460 727 08 30 · drift and hammer · rust converter and seam sealer

repairs.title: Windscreen gasket, wiper spindle and floor leaks
repairs.time: Most of a day for a windscreen reseal (estimate)
repairs.cost: Windscreen gasket $173.80; wiper shaft washer kit $38.10; floor drain kit $47.20 (Expedition Imports)
repairs.symptoms: Wet footwells, rust bubbling around the windscreen frame, water tracking down the A-pillars. Handsome Motors names the windshield gasket perimeter as a classic G rust zone.
repairs.fix: Water-test with a hose and a helper. Reseal the wiper spindles with a new washer kit. If the leak is at the windscreen, the glass has to come out to fit a new gasket. Treat the frame properly while it's exposed, because rust there only spreads. Expedition Imports sells the floor drain kit that's common on 461 trucks and can be retrofitted to a 460, so make sure the floor drains are clear and fitted.
repairs.tools: Windscreen gasket 463 671 02 20 · wiper shaft washer kit 000 824 35 72 · floor drain kit · glass-removal cord and trim tools · rust converter and primer

faq.q: What's the biggest tire I can fit without a lift?
faq.a: The G 300 CDI Professional comes on 265/75R16s, about 31.6 inches. On narrow-body Gs, an Expedition Portal owner runs 235/85R16s (about 32 inches) on the standard steel wheels, which is a sensible no-lift ceiling. Beyond that you're into lift springs: GwagenParts' ROGUE spring listing talks about 33- and 35-inch tires, and warns that bigger tires can trigger ABS and ESP warnings.

faq.q: What's the difference between a W461 and a W463?
faq.a: The W461 uses the W460's narrow body and chassis with W463 running gear, plain trim, and barn doors and panel-van bodies you can't get on a W463. Military trucks also have 24-volt electrics. The [[g-class/w463|W463]] is the luxury civilian G with wood, leather and more electronics.

faq.q: Is the 250 GD 'Wolf' a W460 or a W461?
faq.a: Expedition Motor Company, which restores them, calls the 250 GD Wolf an ex-military W461, and Wikipedia lists the 1990–91 Wolf in the W461 table. The line between late military W460s and early W461s is blurry, so check the VIN and data card on the truck in front of you.

faq.q: Could civilians buy a new W461?
faq.a: Yes, in limited form. Mercedes sold the G 280 CDI EDITION.30 PUR in 2009, followed by the G 280 CDI Professional (2009) and the G 300 CDI Professional (2010–2019). In Australia the G 300 CDI Professional cab-chassis launched in 2016 at A$119,900, and the wagon followed in 2017 at A$109,900.

faq.q: How much can it carry and tow?
faq.a: 4X4 Australia's figures for the G 300 CDI Professional cab-chassis: 2,410 kg kerb weight, 4,490 kg GVM, about 2,080 kg payload and 2,210 kg towing capacity, with a 6,700 kg GCM.

Yes. The G 300 CDI Professional has permanent all-wheel drive with a 50:50 split, a two-speed transfer case and three locking diffs selectable on the move. Unusually, you can unlock the centre diff even in low range.

faq.q: Does it really run on 24 volts?
faq.a: Military W461s do. Wikipedia lists the 24-volt system as one of the W461's defining features, and parts suppliers stock 24 V components such as blower motors. The Australian civilian Professional wagon is described as carrying two 12-volt batteries. Check what your truck actually has before wiring in accessories.

faq.q: Which engine should I look for?
faq.a: For highway use, the 1998–2001 290 GD Turbodiesel or later: the G 270 CDI (156 PS, 400 Nm) and the OM642 V6 in the G 280/300 CDI (184 PS, 400 Nm). The naturally aspirated 290 GD (95 PS) and the 250 GD Wolf are charming and simple but very slow.

faq.q: How big is the fuel tank?
faq.a: 96–97 litres on the G 300 CDI Professional, depending on whether you read WhichCar or 4X4 Australia.

faq.q: Why does the late W461 have a bonnet bulge?
faq.a: It clears an air pump that's part of the emissions equipment, according to 4X4 Australia. The W460 doesn't have one.
No. Civilian production ended in 2019, and military production continued until 2022, when the W464 took over. Mercedes announced the W464 on 1 October 2021.

baseline_service.intro: Ex-fleet and ex-military W461s are often maintained by the book but stored for years, so refresh every fluid and rubber part. Military trucks run 24 V, and glow plugs, bulbs and blower motors must match the system. Specs vary by engine, from the 290 GD to the OM642 CDIs, so confirm capacities and fluid approvals for your VIN.
